fruit: Fresh or frozen whole/cut fruit. Juice belongs to soft_drinks; nuts, dried fruit, prepared fruit meals and ordinary fruit purees belong to other_food.
vegetables: Fresh/frozen vegetables and mushrooms, or plain canned/pickled vegetables. Prepared meals, sauces and fries belong to other_food.
dairy: Animal milk, cheese, yogurt, butter, cream and milk-based puddings/shakes. Merely containing milk does not make a prepared meal dairy. Plant drinks belong to soft_drinks; plant cooking cream belongs to other_food.
alcohol: Beer, wine and spirits. Choose alcohol for a gift bundle containing an alcoholic drink, including a wine-and-chocolate set. Explicitly alcohol-free drinks belong to soft_drinks.
soft_drinks: Water, juice, non-alcoholic beverages, plant milk and instant drink mixes.
other_food: Other HUMAN FOOD: meat, seafood, eggs, bakery, snacks, grains, spices, nuts, baking ingredients (including baking soda, baking powder and yeast), dry tea/coffee, hummus, sauces and prepared meals. NEVER tobacco, nicotine, cigarettes, cosmetics, cleaning products or food supplements.
baby_food: Food or tea explicitly intended for infants. Junior/children branding alone does not establish infant use; ordinary children's food belongs to other_food.
baby_care: Non-food products explicitly for infants: diapers, baby wipes, pacifiers, feeding equipment, walkers and baby toiletries. Baby garments belong to clothing_accessories; general children's toiletries belong to personal_care.
personal_care: Human hygiene, cosmetics, oral care, sanitary pads, condoms, hair/skin products, combs, grooming tools and hair appliances. Hair clips belong to clothing_accessories. Protective respirators belong to other; cosmetic face masks belong here.
cleaning: Cleaning/laundry chemicals, mops/refills (моп, џогер, резерва за џогер), cleaning brushes, scourers, cleaning cloths, rubbish bags, household insect/moth control, moisture-absorber refills and general air fresheners. Paper napkins, toilet/kitchen paper and general storage belong to household. Vehicle-specific products belong to automotive.
automotive: Products identified as vehicle supplies or care: vehicle fluids, ice scrapers, car cleaners/cloths/air fresheners and trailer straps. Generic cleaners without evidence of vehicle use belong to cleaning; do not infer vehicle use from an unrelated code.
clothing_accessories: Garments, shoes, baby clothing, wearable costumes/hats, handbags, luggage, umbrellas, belts and hair clips. Combs/grooming tools belong to personal_care; decorative non-wearable ribbons belong to household.
pet: Food and supplies explicitly for animals, including pet bowls and toys. A suggestive brand name alone does not establish pet use.
household: Home/table/kitchen goods, cookware, domestic electrical supplies, batteries, linens, storage, mirrors, furniture/stools, coat hangers and empty reusable bottles. Includes candles, lanterns, Christmas trees, Easter/party decorations, gift bags/boxes/ribbons, balloons, napkins and toilet/kitchen paper. Cleaning tools belong to cleaning; grooming tools belong to personal_care.
other: An IDENTIFIABLE product outside the above categories: all tobacco/nicotine/cigarettes and their filters/mouthpieces, lighters, books, stationery/art supplies, general toys, recreational beach equipment, food supplements and protective respirators. Being outside the named categories is NOT insufficient information.
unknown: The supplied source cannot identify the product kind. Do not choose unknown merely because a product has no dedicated category: an identifiable uncategorized product belongs to other. Do not invent a product kind from an unexplained brand/code.
